title: 初一家人表：诺亚
audio_introduction: Read the whole table. Listen and complete all five blanks.
instruction: 听一篇完整家庭介绍，完成四行信息表的全部5空。每空一词；数目和年龄也可填对应阿拉伯数字，不加years等已印词。每材料听两遍。源未印精确读答停顿；本机每题前后各5秒，只作审阅编排，可重播。

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: Hello, I am Noah. Let me tell you about the people in my family photo. Rose and John are my grandparents. They have two children. One of their children is my father, Mark. Here is Lily, my sister. Lily is five years old. And this is my uncle, Paul. Paul lives in London now. We talk on the phone every Sunday.

questions.rationale: 录音完整陈述支持此空：Rose and John have two children.。英文数词与对应阿拉伯数字同等接受；不加已印出的children或years old。
录音完整陈述支持此空：Mark is Noah's father.。按录音中的亲属身份填一词，不从姓名猜性别或关系。
